brief:
Farmers in Al-Jab'a, west of Bethlehem, cannot reach their olive groves during harvest season, the Palestine News Network reported. The village's traditional olive harvest—once a defining season for residents—has become inaccessible to its owners, leaving the trees unharvested.

The restrictions prevent Palestinians from reaching agricultural land they own, disrupting a harvest cycle central to the village economy and cultural life.
dek: BETHLEHEM, West Bank / PNN / The olive harvest in the village of Al-Jab’a, west of Bethlehem, is no longer the season its residents remember.
title: Al-Jab'a farmers blocked from olive harvest west of Bethlehem
